name: SpotDrop Booking
author: spotdrop

sections.description:
SpotDrop is an online booking system for salons, sports venues and other service businesses. This plugin shows your SpotDrop booking form on your own pages.

  • Connect your SpotDrop account with one click. You sign in on spotdrop.si and approve the connection.
  • Your site is added to the websites allowed to show your booking automatically. No codes to copy.
  • Add the “SpotDrop booking” block in the block editor, or use the [spotdrop slug="your-spot"] shortcode in Elementor, Divi or the classic editor.
  • The booking adjusts its height to its content, on phones and computers.

You need a SpotDrop account with an active spot. The plugin itself is free.

What the connection allows

The connection only lets this site see the list of your spots and add or remove this site’s own domain from the websites allowed to show your booking. It cannot see your customers, appointments or revenue, change your settings, or allow any other website.

External services

This plugin connects to SpotDrop (https://www.spotdrop.si), the booking service it embeds.

  • When you click “Connect to SpotDrop”, your site registers itself with SpotDrop (it sends the address of its settings page) and opens the SpotDrop sign-in page in your browser. After you approve, your site exchanges a one-time code for access tokens. The tokens are stored in your WordPress database and are only sent to SpotDrop.
  • While connected, the settings page and the block editor load the list of your spots from SpotDrop, and the “Allow on this site” button sends this site’s domain to SpotDrop.
  • Pages with the block or shortcode show the SpotDrop booking page in an iframe. Your visitors’ browsers then load that page from spotdrop.si, and the booking data they enter is sent to SpotDrop.
  • Disconnecting or deleting the plugin removes this site from your spots and revokes the tokens.

SpotDrop terms of use: https://www.spotdrop.si/terms
SpotDrop privacy policy: https://www.spotdrop.si/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → SpotDrop and click “Connect to SpotDrop”.
  3. Sign in on spotdrop.si and approve the connection.
  4. If you have more than one spot, click “Allow on this site” next to the ones you want to show.
  5. Add the “SpotDrop booking” block to a page, or paste the shortcode shown in the settings.

Your site must use HTTPS.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SpotDrop account?

Yes. The plugin shows the booking of a SpotDrop spot that you own.

Does the plugin store my customers’ data?

No. Bookings are made on SpotDrop inside the iframe. The plugin stores only the connection tokens and the list of your spots.

Can I show several spots?

Yes. Allow each spot on this site in Settings → SpotDrop and add one block or shortcode per spot. Each spot can be shown on up to five websites.

Which language is the booking in?

The language of the page: Slovenian on Slovenian pages, English otherwise. You can choose it in the block settings, or with the shortcode: [spotdrop slug="your-spot" lang="sl"] or lang="en".

Why is the booking not shown on my page?

The booking is shown only when this site is connected and the spot is allowed on it. Open Settings → SpotDrop: the spot should say “Shown on this site”. While you are logged in, the page tells you what is missing.
